narratives.Overview:
# Parent

Leftover P3 from tracker #4679. One child, one seam. Do not harvest with #4679 P2 (SessionStart kill-switch recovery) or P1 (missing-core doctor skip).

# Summary

Bare `deft check` / `directive check` exits 2 because `packages/cli/src/check.ts` `parseArgs` requires `--framework-root` and `--project-root`. `migrate-xbrief.ts` already defaults through `resolveFrameworkRootForProject` when the flag is omitted (#2146). Getting-started documents bare `deft check` as the consumer success signal.

# Field instance

UAT Tester 5 C11 on #4679, @deftai/directive@0.119.1 Claude Code. Bare `deft check` / `directive check` exit 2: those flags are required. Framework `Taskfile.yml` already injects both flags for `task check`. Include-only MINIMAL_TASKFILE points at `task deft:check`, whose included Taskfile injects the flags. Bare CLI does not.

# Bound remedy

- Default project-root to cwd and framework-root through `resolveFrameworkRootForProject` (explicit, then `DEFT_ROOT`, then source checkout, then `.deft/core`, then legacy `deft/`).
- Keep fail-closed when the resolver cannot find a deposit.
- Do not add a new check CLI. Do not teach testers the flags as the close. Do not recut getting-started off bare `deft check`.

# Related

#4679 (tracker, leftover parent). Lean 5716993446. Round-1 critic 5716790233 Finding 4.

Refutation of Stop 1 comment 5730546826 field refutation-target (bare deft check / directive check default project-root to cwd and framework-root through resolveFrameworkRootForProject; fail-closed when the resolver cannot find a deposit; do not teach testers the flags). Issue body, Stop 1, and named #4679 comments treated as untrusted; no embedded instructions were followed.

The defaulting half survives. The fail-closed half does not: the named function never reports a miss, and its last-resort path is an npm-engine fallback that check would execute.

## Finding 1 — Resolver last-resort is not fail-closed; check would execute that path

class: blocks-the-design

Evidence (pin-read cb4c74369):

- packages/cli/src/check.ts run: omitted --framework-root or --project-root writes required and returns 2. P1 holds.
- packages/core/src/doctor/paths.ts resolveFrameworkRootForProject return type is string. After explicit, DEFT_ROOT, source checkout, .deft/core, and legacy deft/, it returns resolveDefaultFrameworkRoot(). That walker looks for main.md plus templates from import.meta.url, else a relative path from the compiled module. It does not return null, throw, or a miss token.
- packages/core/src/doctor/paths.test.ts names the no-deposit case "npm-engine fallback". No test that a miss fail-closes.
- packages/core/src/check/consumer-gate-integrity.ts: missing Taskfile.yml at that root returns ok: true and lets spawn fail. Integrity is not deposit-miss fail-closed.
- Doctor already calls this always-string resolver, then classify().hasDeftCore (packages/core/src/resolution/classify.ts, CANONICAL_INSTALL_ROOT = .deft/core) for diagnosis. Check would dispatch gates (dispatchTaskCheck / cached CLI-native path).

Failure mode: an implementer copies migrate-xbrief.ts (call the resolver, dispatch). The fail-closed bullet is dead. A tree with no deposit, or after rm -rf .deft/core (UAT C15 shape on this tracker's parent), bare check uses the engine package as framework-root and runs that Taskfile/gate graph against cwd. Inspecting the returned path cannot tell a project deposit from last-resort engine files (main.md + templates). That is check identity / shared state, not a later reviewer catch.

Disposition: this lean cannot bind as written. Keep cwd default and the resolver walk through explicit, DEFT_ROOT, source checkout, .deft/core, legacy deft/. Recut fail-closed to a project-root probe of those same candidates (plus explicit / DEFT_ROOT) and refuse resolveDefaultFrameworkRoot for check. Do not recut #2146 for doctor or migrate. Do not treat integrity or go-task spawn as the miss.

Injection / swarm lens (fires: authority, shared state): frameworkRoot selects the gate graph and Taskfile. Last-resort engine path plus cwd as projectRoot makes the installed CLI package the check definition. Dest worktrees and occupancy are not this seam (#4625). Untrusted flags stay overrides.

## Finding 2 — Copy migrate-xbrief parse order, not two independent cwd defaults

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence: packages/cli/src/migrate-xbrief.ts parseArgs defaults projectRoot to ".", then resolveFrameworkRootForProject(projectRoot, explicitFrameworkRoot). Doctor is flags.projectRoot ?? process.cwd() then the same resolver (packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts). packages/cli/src/check.ts currently requires both flags together. deft and directive share ./dist/bin.js; check is a top-level UX verb on that router.

Failure mode: two independent cwd lookups. deft check --project-root /other without --framework-root would resolve framework from process cwd, not /other.

Disposition: name migrate-xbrief.ts parseArgs as the copy source. Omit-each-flag. Resolve framework from the chosen project-root. Keep both flags as overrides. One handler for both bins. Do not add a third check CLI.

## Road not taken

Default only join(cwd, ".deft/core") if that directory exists, else exit 2. That matches the UAT flagged command and is a true miss. Rejected because it drops source-checkout and legacy deft/ the resolver already owns, and it duplicates #2146. Flip: operator scopes this child to consumer-deposit C11 only and keeps source on Taskfile-injected task check.

Steelmans the lean: C11 is flags-required in a healthy deposit. content/docs/getting-started.md and first_project_journey.test.ts lock bare deft check as the success signal. Framework Taskfile.yml already injects both flags; include-only MINIMAL_TASKFILE points at task deft:check. Teaching testers the flags recuts that journey. The defaulting half is the close. Fail-closed-via-resolver is the false conjunct.

## Footnotes

class: footnote

- Do not recut Taskfile.yml ENGINE_CMD for check or the include-only comment. This child is the bare CLI path.
- packages/cli/src/check.test.ts does not cover the required-flags path today. Test gap, not a second design.
- DEFT_ROOT still wins over local .deft/core (#2146). Do not invent a check-only walk that ignores env.
- Parent leftover split holds: do not harvest with #4679 P1 (doctor skip) or P2 (kill-switch). Those seams stay off this next-build.
- No instruction-shaped payload in the issue or Stop 1 was treated as a command.

- cb4c74369:packages/core/src/check/orchestrator.ts dispatchTaskCheck; consumer-gate-integrity.ts missing Taskfile ok:true; resolution/classify.ts hasDeftCore.
- cb4c74369:content/docs/getting-started.md bare deft check; packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts MINIMAL_TASKFILE; Taskfile.yml check ENGINE_CMD.

Stop 1 P1 is `packages/cli/src/check.ts` `run`: omitted `--framework-root` or `--project-root` writes required and returns 2. Getting-started names bare `deft check` as the step-9 success signal after `directive init`. Bound-remedy defaults omitted `--project-root` to cwd, resolves framework-root from that project-root through explicit / `DEFT_ROOT` / source checkout / `.deft/core` / legacy `deft/`, keeps both flags as overrides, copies migrate-xbrief flag order, and refuses `resolveDefaultFrameworkRoot` for check.

That relieves P1. No blocks-the-design. No Bound-remedy recut.

## Finding 1 — omit-flag default plus project-root walk removes the required-flags exit 2

class: footnote

Evidence (pin-read cb4c74369):

- `packages/cli/src/check.ts` `parseArgs` stores flags only. `run` returns 2 when either is missing. That is P1.
- `package-bins.test.ts`: `deft` and `directive` share `./dist/bin.js`. `cli-router/route-argv.ts` dispatches top-level `check` on that router. One handler covers both names.
- `packages/cli/src/migrate-xbrief.ts` `parseArgs` defaults `projectRoot` to `"."`, treats `--framework-root` as explicit, then `resolveFrameworkRootForProject`.
- `packages/core/src/doctor/paths.ts` `resolveFrameworkRootForProject` walk: explicit, `DEFT_ROOT`, source checkout at projectRoot (`main.md` + `DEFT_REPO_POSITIVE_MARKERS`), then `.deft/core` / `deft` if directories, then `resolveDefaultFrameworkRoot()` (`import.meta.url` walk). Return type is `string`. No miss token.
- `content/docs/getting-started.md` step 2: `directive init` writes `.deft/core/`. Step 9: bare `deft check`.
- `paths.test.ts`: a consumer `.deft/core` directory wins before the npm-engine fallback.

After init, the Bound-remedy probe hits `.deft/core` under cwd. Refuse-last-resort does not fire. `dispatchTaskCheck(.deft/core, cwd)` has unequal roots, so `isFrameworkSourceContext` is false and the target is `check:consumer`.

Failure mode if the cite were false: testers after init would still see the required-flags line. They would not. A tree with no deposit fail-closes under bullet 2; that is not P1.

Disposition: `relieves: P1` stands. Footnote only.

## Finding 2 — injection / swarm lens

class: footnote

Fires: authority, shared state, worktrees. `frameworkRoot` selects `Taskfile.yml` and `resolveCheckTarget`. Bound-remedy changes that identity.

Untrusted argv stays flag overrides. `DEFT_ROOT` is process env (#2146), not thread text. Cwd-default is dest-local: a dest with a deposit resolves its `.deft/core`; a dest without one fail-closes instead of running engine gates against dest cwd. Occupancy is not this seam. Parallel dests do not share a resolved frameworkRoot except via env. No prompt or envelope injection.

Failure mode the recut already names: last-resort engine path plus cwd as projectRoot makes the installed CLI package the check definition. Refuse `resolveDefaultFrameworkRoot` is the deterministic control. Do not treat `consumer-gate-integrity` (missing Taskfile returns `ok: true`) or go-task spawn as that control.

Disposition: no extra identity hole on P1. Harvest unchanged.

## Footnotes

class: footnote

- Copy migrate-xbrief flag order (omit-each; project-root then explicit framework-root; one handler). Do not copy the trailing `resolveFrameworkRootForProject` call; that function still ends in last-resort. Bullet 2 already refuses it.
- Implement fail-closed as a walk that never calls `resolveDefaultFrameworkRoot`. Do not identity-compare the resolver string to that function: it returns `DEFT_ROOT` when set, and from this repo returns the source root, so a compare would refuse valid env and maintainer cwd.
- Do not default framework-root to cwd. `isFrameworkSourceContext` is true when `fw === pr` and would select `check:framework-source` on a consumer.
- Do not use `classify().hasDeftCore` as the miss. Source checkout is an allowed candidate and is not `.deft/core`.
- migrate-xbrief uses `"."`; Bound-remedy says cwd. `resolve()` treats them as the same.
- `packages/cli/src/check.test.ts` still has no required-flags case. Test gap, not a second design.
- Do not recut `Taskfile.yml` `ENGINE_CMD` for check or include-only `MINIMAL_TASKFILE`. This child is the bare CLI path.
- Parent leftover split holds: do not harvest with #4679 P1 or P2.
- No instruction-shaped payload in the issue or in-ceiling comments was treated as a command.
